' CYBORG SWARM - a swarm shooter for the MEGA65, in NTC BASIC (m65 platform)
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
'
' The swarm flies in, takes its places in the formation and dives at your fighter. Queens take
' two hits and can beam your fighter up: shoot the Queen while she dives and your fighter comes
' back as a second one beside you (twice the fire). Every fourth stage is a bonus stage.
' Joystick in port 2: left / right to move, fire to fire (and to start). RETURN pauses.

Option Explicit

' ---- sprites (Vic's: 0 is in front)
Const SP_P1 = 0             ' the fighter
Const SP_P2 = 1             ' the second fighter (rescued)
Const SP_MIS = 2            ' missiles: 2-5
Const SP_EB = 6             ' enemy shots: 6-13
Const SP_BEAM = 14          ' the tractor beam: 14-19
Const SP_PEX = 64           ' the fighter's explosion
Const SP_POP = 65           ' a score shown where a Queen fell
Const SP_TITLE = 66         ' the title's enemies: 66-68, its logo 69-79

' ---- the playfield (pixels) and the fighter
Const PY = 178              ' the fighter's line
Const PXMIN = 12
Const PXMAX = 244
Const NMIS = 4
Const NEB = 8

' ---- game state
Dim score As Long, hi As Long, nextLife As Long
Dim lives As Integer, stage As Integer, bonusStage As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, phase As Integer, phaseT As Integer
Dim alive As Integer, entering As Integer
Dim joyNow As Integer, joyWas As Integer, paused As Integer, key As Integer

' the fighter: x in 1/16 pixels, state 0 flying, 1 exploding, 2 waiting, 3 being beamed up,
' 4 none left; dual = a second fighter on the right
Dim px As Integer, pstate As Integer, pt As Integer, dual As Integer, pspin As Integer, pyy As Integer
Dim mx(3) As Integer, my(3) As Integer, ma(3) As Integer
Dim bx(7) As Integer, by(7) As Integer, bdx(7) As Integer, bba(7) As Integer
Dim shots As Long, hits As Long

' the entries: for each enemy (its index) when it starts, its path, where from, mirrored
Dim qn As Integer, qi As Integer
Dim qe(39) As Integer, qt(39) As Integer, qp(39) As Integer, qx(39) As Integer, qy(39) As Integer, qa(39) As Integer, qm(39) As Integer

' the formation's sway and breathing, the dives
Dim swayD As Integer, breath As Integer, breathD As Integer, diveT As Integer
Dim cap(3) As Integer       ' Queen q has captured a fighter (it is enemy 40 + q)
Dim escK(3) As Integer      ' escorts a diving Queen has lost
Dim escN(3) As Integer      ' escorts she set off with

' the tractor beam: the Queen (-1 none), how long
Dim beamQ As Integer, beamT As Integer, freeing As Integer

' the score popup
Dim popT As Integer

' sound: a tune's notes (period, frames), where it is
Dim tune(63) As Integer, tuneN As Integer, tuneI As Integer, tuneW As Integer
Dim starY As Integer, starT As Integer
Dim starCol(5) As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
Dim pexT As Integer, pexX As Integer, bonusHits As Integer

' ============================================================
' the start
' ============================================================
Vic.Screen 1
Vic.Colors Gfx.Palettes(), 16, 64
Vic.Images Gfx.Images()
Vic.Field 32
Swarm.Init
starCol(0) = &HFFF: starCol(1) = &HFF0: starCol(2) = &HF0F: starCol(3) = &H0F0
starCol(4) = &H88F: starCol(5) = &HEC8
MakeStars
hi = 20000
Randomize
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ============================================================
' the title
' ============================================================
Sub Title()
  Dim w As Integer
  Cls
  Vic.HideAll
  Vic.Box 256, 0, 64, 200, 0
  Sid.Quiet
  Logo 10, 3
  Pen 1
  Locate 10, 10: Print "- SCORE ADVANCE -"
  Pen 0
  Locate 16, 14: Print "50    100"
  Locate 16, 17: Print "80    160"
  Locate 16, 20: Print "150   400 - 1600"
  Pen 2
  Locate 13, 12: Print "IN FORMATION  DIVING"
  Pen 3
  Locate 5, 25: Print "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN PTY LTD"
  Pen 1
  Locate 35, 1: Print "HIGH"
  Pen 0
  ShowNum 33, 2, hi
  Vic.Sprite SP_TITLE, 88, 100, Gfx.I_DRONE, Vic.FlipY + Vic.Palette * 2
  Vic.Sprite SP_TITLE + 1, 88, 124, Gfx.I_HORNET, Vic.FlipY + Vic.Palette * 2
  Vic.Sprite SP_TITLE + 2, 88, 148, Gfx.I_QUEEN, Vic.FlipY + Vic.Palette
  w = 0
  joyNow = Joy.Read(2)
  Do
    Vic.Update
    Sid.Update
    Stars
    w = w + 1
    If (w And 32) = 0 Then
      Pen 2
      Locate 13, 23: Print "PUSH FIRE BUTTON"
    Else
      Locate 13, 23: Print "                "
    End If
    joyWas = joyNow
    joyNow = Joy.Read(2)
    key = Inkey
  Loop Until (((joyNow And Joy.Fire) <> 0) And ((joyWas And Joy.Fire) = 0)) Or (key = 13)
  Randomize                         ' from the time of the press: each game different
  Pen 0
  For i = 0 To 13
    Vic.Hide SP_TITLE + i
  Next
End Sub

' the logo: CYBORG on one line, SWARM under it, from column x, row y (2 x 2 cells a letter)
Sub Logo(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  k = SP_TITLE + 3
  LogoWord "CYBORG", x, y
  LogoWord "SWARM", x + 1, y + 2
End Sub

Sub LogoWord(ByVal w As String, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, c As Integer
  For j = 1 To Len(w)
    c = InStr(Gfx.LOGO_LETTERS, Mid$(w, j, 1)) - 1
    Vic.Sprite k, (x - 1 + (j - 1) * 3) * 8, (y - 1) * 8, Gfx.I_LOGO + c, Vic.Palette * 2
    k = k + 1
  Next
End Sub

' the text colour: palette p's colour 1 (0 white, 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 cyan)
Sub Pen(ByVal p As Integer)
  Vic.Pen 17 + p * 16
End Sub

' ============================================================
' a game
' ============================================================
Sub Game()
  score = 0
  nextLife = 20000
  lives = 2
  stage = 0
  shots = 0
  hits = 0
  dual = 0
  For i = 0 To 3
    cap(i) = 0
  Next
  Cls
  Vic.HideAll
  px = 128 * 16
  pstate = 0
  Hud
  NextStage
  Do
    Vic.Update
    Sid.Update
    joyWas = joyNow
    joyNow = Joy.Read(2)
    key = Inkey
    If key = 13 Then Pause
    Stars
    Player
    Missiles
    Swarm.ptx = px
    Swarm.pty = PY * 16
    Swarm.Step
    Formation
    EnemyShots
    Collide
    Entries
    Dives
    Beam
    FreeFighter
    Popup
    TuneUpdate
    Flow
    frames = frames + 1
  Loop Until phase = 9
End Sub

' RETURN: stop everything until RETURN again
Sub Pause()
  Sid.Quiet
  Pen 2
  Locate 13, 16: Print "PAUSE"
  Do
    Vic.Update
    key = Inkey
  Loop Until key = 13
  ClearRow 16
  Pen 0
End Sub

' the stage's flow: 0 its name, 1 coming in and fighting, 2 cleared, 3 the bonus stage's score,
' 9 game over
Sub Flow()
  phaseT = phaseT + 1
  Select Case phase
    Case 0
      If phaseT = 150 Then
        ClearRow 13
        ClearRow 15
        phase = 1
        phaseT = 0
      End If
    Case 1
      If (qi >= qn) And (Remaining() = 0) And (beamQ < 0) And (freeing = 0) Then
        If OnScreen() = 0 Then
          phaseT = 0
          If bonusStage Then
            phase = 3
            BonusScore
          Else
            phase = 2
          End If
        End If
      End If
    Case 2
      If phaseT = 60 Then NextStage
    Case 3
      If phaseT = 240 Then
        ClearRow 11
        ClearRow 13
        ClearRow 15
        NextStage
      End If
  End Select
  ' one of two fighters hit: its explosion
  If pexT > 0 Then
    pexT = pexT + 1
    If pexT < 64 Then
      Vic.Sprite SP_PEX, pexX - 16, PY - 16, Gfx.I_PEXPL + pexT \ 16, Vic.Palette
    Else
      Vic.Hide SP_PEX
      pexT = 0
    End If
  End If
  ' the fighter
  If pstate = 1 Then
    pt = pt + 1
    If pt < 64 Then
      Vic.Sprite SP_PEX, px \ 16 - 16, PY - 16, Gfx.I_PEXPL + pt \ 16, Vic.Palette
    Else
      Vic.Hide SP_PEX
      pstate = 2
      pt = 0
    End If
  ElseIf pstate = 2 Then
    pt = pt + 1
    If pt = 30 Then
      If lives = 0 Then
        Pen 1
        Locate 11, 16: Print "GAME  OVER"
        Pen 0
        pstate = 4
        pt = 0
      End If
    End If
    If (pt > 90) And (lives > 0) And (OnScreen() = 0) And (beamQ < 0) And (freeing = 0) Then
      lives = lives - 1
      pstate = 0
      px = 128 * 16
      ShowLives
      Locate 13, 16: Print "      "
    ElseIf (pt = 60) And (lives > 0) Then
      ClearRow 16
      Pen 3
      Locate 13, 16: Print "READY"
      Pen 0
    End If
  ElseIf pstate = 4 Then
    pt = pt + 1
    If pt = 200 Then
      Vic.HideAll
      Sid.Quiet
      Results
      phase = 9
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' a row of the playfield cleared (its 32 columns)
Sub ClearRow(ByVal r As Integer)
  Locate 1, r
  Print Space$(32);
End Sub

' how many of the 40 are still there (any state)
Function Remaining() As Integer
  Dim j As Integer, c As Integer
  c = 0
  For j = 0 To 39
    If Swarm.es(j) <> 0 Then c = c + 1
  Next
  Remaining = c
End Function

' how many enemies are flying (not in the formation, not gone)
Function OnScreen() As Integer
  Dim j As Integer, c As Integer
  c = 0
  For j = 0 To 43
    If (Swarm.es(j) <> 0) And (Swarm.es(j) <> Swarm.S_FORM) And (Swarm.es(j) <> Swarm.S_HELD) Then c = c + 1
  Next
  OnScreen = c
End Function

' the next stage: its name and its entries
Sub NextStage()
  stage = stage + 1
  bonusStage = ((stage Mod 4) = 3)
  phase = 0
  phaseT = 0
  frames = 0
  beamQ = -1
  freeing = 0
  breath = 0
  breathD = 1
  swayD = 4
  Swarm.fcx = 128 * 16
  Swarm.sprx = 128
  Swarm.spry = 256
  diveT = 200
  For i = 0 To 43
    Swarm.es(i) = 0
    If i < 40 Then Swarm.eh(i) = 1
  Next
  For i = 0 To 3
    Swarm.eh(i) = 2
    Swarm.ek(i) = Swarm.K_QUEEN
    Swarm.ek(40 + i) = Swarm.K_FIGHTER
    Swarm.eo(40 + i) = i
  Next
  For i = 4 To 19
    Swarm.ek(i) = Swarm.K_HORNET
  Next
  For i = 20 To 39
    Swarm.ek(i) = Swarm.K_DRONE
  Next
  For i = 0 To NEB - 1
    bba(i) = 0
    Vic.Hide SP_EB + i
  Next
  HideBeam
  Vic.Hide SP_POP
  alive = 40
  bonusHits = 0
  If bonusStage Then
    BonusEntries
    Pen 3
    Locate 11, 13: Print "BONUS STAGE"
    Pen 0
    TuneStart 2
  Else
    StageEntries
    Pen 3
    Locate 13, 13: Print "STAGE "; stage
    Pen 0
    TuneStart 1
  End If
  If pstate = 0 Then
    Pen 1
    Locate 13, 15: Print "READY"
    Pen 0
  End If
  Hud
End Sub

' ============================================================
' the entries
' ============================================================
' a group: n enemies from the list s (their indices, "," between), from x, y facing a, on path p,
' mirrored m, the first at frame t0, then every dt frames
Sub Group(ByVal s As String, ByVal p As Integer, ByVal x0 As Integer, ByVal y0 As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal m As Integer, ByVal t0 As Integer, ByVal dt As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, c As Integer, v As Integer
  j = 1
  c = 0
  Do While j <= Len(s)
    v = Val(Mid$(s, j))
    qe(qn) = v
    qt(qn) = t0 + c * dt
    qp(qn) = p
    qx(qn) = x0
    qy(qn) = y0
    qa(qn) = a
    qm(qn) = m
    qn = qn + 1
    c = c + 1
    Do While (j <= Len(s)) And (Mid$(s, j, 1) <> ",")
      j = j + 1
    Loop
    j = j + 1
  Loop
End Sub

' a normal stage: 5 waves of 8
Sub StageEntries()
  qn = 0
  qi = 0
  ' two columns from the top: Drones on the left, Hornets on the right
  Group "24,34,25,35", Paths.P_TOP, 104, -8, 512, 0, 0, 10
  Group "7,15,8,16", Paths.P_TOP, 152, -8, 512, 1, 0, 10
  ' Queens and Hornets from the bottom left
  Group "0,4,1,5,2,10,3,11", Paths.P_SIDE, -8, 164, 128, 0, 170, 9
  ' Hornets from the bottom right
  Group "6,12,9,13,14,17,18,19", Paths.P_SIDE, 264, 164, 896, 1, 330, 9
  ' Drones from the top right, then the top left
  Group "26,36,27,37,28,38,29,39", Paths.P_TOP, 152, -8, 512, 1, 490, 9
  Group "20,30,21,31,22,32,23,33", Paths.P_TOP, 104, -8, 512, 0, 650, 9
End Sub

' a bonus stage: 5 groups of 8 through and away, no shots
Sub BonusEntries()
  qn = 0
  qi = 0
  Group "20,21,22,23,24,25,26,27", Paths.P_C1, 104, -8, 512, 2, 0, 8
  Group "4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11", Paths.P_C2, -8, 144, 200, 2, 150, 8
  Group "12,13,14,15,16,17,18,19", Paths.P_C2, 264, 144, 824, 3, 300, 8
  Group "0,28,1,29,2,30,3,31", Paths.P_C3, 152, -8, 512, 3, 450, 8
  Group "32,33,34,35,36,37,38,39", Paths.P_C4, -8, 36, 300, 2, 600, 8
End Sub

' the entries due now
Sub Entries()
  Do While qi < qn
    If (phase <> 1) Or (frames < qt(qi) + 150) Then Exit Sub
    i = qe(qi)
    Swarm.Launch i, qp(qi), qx(qi), qy(qi), qa(qi), qm(qi)
    If (i < 4) And cap(i) Then Swarm.es(40 + i) = Swarm.S_HELD
    qi = qi + 1
  Loop
End Sub

' ============================================================
' the formation: it sways while they come in, then breathes
' ============================================================
Sub Formation()
  If qi < qn Then
    Swarm.fcx = Swarm.fcx + swayD
    If (Swarm.fcx > 144 * 16) Or (Swarm.fcx < 112 * 16) Then swayD = -swayD
  Else
    If Swarm.fcx > 128 * 16 Then
      Swarm.fcx = Swarm.fcx - 4
    ElseIf Swarm.fcx < 128 * 16 Then
      Swarm.fcx = Swarm.fcx + 4
    End If
    If (frames And 1) = 0 Then
      breath = breath + breathD
      If (breath >= 32) Or (breath <= 0) Then breathD = -breathD
      Swarm.sprx = 128 + breath
      Swarm.spry = 256 + breath
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' ============================================================
' the fighter
' ============================================================
Sub Player()
  Dim v As Integer
  If pstate = 3 Then
    ' being beamed up: turning round, rising to the Queen
    pspin = pspin + 1
    If pyy > Swarm.ey(beamQ) \ 16 + 20 Then pyy = pyy - 1
    v = (pspin \ 3) And 15
    FighterSprite SP_P1, px \ 16, pyy, v, 1
    If (pyy <= Swarm.ey(beamQ) \ 16 + 20) Then Captured
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If pstate <> 0 Then
    Vic.Hide SP_P1
    Vic.Hide SP_P2
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If (joyNow And Joy.Left) <> 0 Then px = px - 32
  If (joyNow And Joy.Right) <> 0 Then px = px + 32
  If px < PXMIN * 16 Then px = PXMIN * 16
  If dual Then
    If px > (PXMAX - 16) * 16 Then px = (PXMAX - 16) * 16
  Else
    If px > PXMAX * 16 Then px = PXMAX * 16
  End If
  FighterSprite SP_P1, px \ 16, PY, 0, 0
  If dual Then
    FighterSprite SP_P2, px \ 16 + 16, PY, 0, 0
  Else
    Vic.Hide SP_P2
  End If
  ' fire: the button pressed
  If ((joyNow And Joy.Fire) <> 0) And ((joyWas And Joy.Fire) = 0) And (phase = 1) Then Fire
End Sub

' the fighter's sprite at x, y (its middle), facing direction dir (0-15: 0 up), red if captured
Sub FighterSprite(ByVal sp As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal dir As Integer, ByVal red As Integer)
  Dim f As Integer, fl As Integer
  If dir <= 4 Then
    f = dir: fl = 0
  ElseIf dir <= 8 Then
    f = 8 - dir: fl = Vic.FlipY
  ElseIf dir <= 12 Then
    f = dir - 8: fl = Vic.FlipX Or Vic.FlipY
  Else
    f = 16 - dir: fl = Vic.FlipX
  End If
  If red Then
    fl = fl + Vic.Palette * 3
  Else
    fl = fl + Vic.Palette
  End If
  Vic.Sprite sp, x - 8, y - 8, Gfx.I_FIGHTER + f, fl
End Sub

Sub Fire()
  Dim j As Integer, c As Integer, need As Integer
  need = 1
  If dual Then need = 2
  c = 0
  For j = 0 To NMIS - 1
    If ma(j) = 0 Then c = c + 1
  Next
  If c < need Then Exit Sub
  If (dual = 0) And (c < 3) Then Exit Sub      ' one fighter: 2 missiles at a time
  For j = 0 To NMIS - 1
    If (ma(j) = 0) And (need > 0) Then
      ma(j) = 1
      mx(j) = px
      If need = 1 And dual Then mx(j) = px + 256
      my(j) = (PY - 8) * 16
      need = need - 1
    End If
  Next
  shots = shots + 1
  Sid.Play 0, 160, 26, 11, 10
End Sub

Sub Missiles()
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = 0 To NMIS - 1
    If ma(j) Then
      my(j) = my(j) - 112
      If my(j) < 0 Then
        ma(j) = 0
        Vic.Hide SP_MIS + j
      Else
        Vic.Sprite SP_MIS + j, mx(j) \ 16 - 4, my(j) \ 16 - 4, Gfx.I_MISSILE, Vic.Palette
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ============================================================
' enemy shots
' ============================================================
Sub EnemyShots()
  Dim j As Integer, e As Integer, dy As Integer
  ' those that have just aimed may shoot
  For j = 0 To Swarm.fqn - 1
    e = Swarm.fq(j)
    If (bonusStage = 0) And (pstate = 0) And (Rnd(100) < 30 + stage * 6) Then
      If Swarm.ey(e) < 134 * 16 Then
        For k = 0 To NEB - 1
          If bba(k) = 0 Then
            bba(k) = 1
            bx(k) = Swarm.ex(e)
            by(k) = Swarm.ey(e) + 128
            dy = PY * 16 - by(k)
            If dy < 256 Then dy = 256
            bdx(k) = (px - bx(k)) \ (dy \ 64)
            If bdx(k) > 40 Then bdx(k) = 40
            If bdx(k) < -40 Then bdx(k) = -40
            Exit For
          End If
        Next
      End If
    End If
  Next
  Swarm.fqn = 0
  For j = 0 To NEB - 1
    If bba(j) Then
      bx(j) = bx(j) + bdx(j)
      by(j) = by(j) + 64
      If by(j) > 204 * 16 Then
        bba(j) = 0
        Vic.Hide SP_EB + j
      Else
        Vic.Sprite SP_EB + j, bx(j) \ 16 - 4, by(j) \ 16 - 4, Gfx.I_EBULLET, Vic.Palette * 2
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ============================================================
' collisions
' ============================================================
Sub Collide()
  Dim j As Integer, e As Integer
  For j = 0 To NMIS - 1
    If ma(j) Then
      e = Swarm.Hit(mx(j), my(j), 7 * 16)
      If e >= 0 Then
        ma(j) = 0
        Vic.Hide SP_MIS + j
        Shot e
      End If
    End If
  Next
  If pstate <> 0 Then Exit Sub
  ' the enemy shots, the enemies themselves
  For j = 0 To NEB - 1
    If bba(j) Then
      If Abs(bx(j) - px) < 6 * 16 And Abs(by(j) - PY * 16) < 8 * 16 Then
        bba(j) = 0
        Vic.Hide SP_EB + j
        FighterHit 0
        Exit Sub
      End If
      If dual Then
        If Abs(bx(j) - px - 256) < 6 * 16 And Abs(by(j) - PY * 16) < 8 * 16 Then
          bba(j) = 0
          Vic.Hide SP_EB + j
          FighterHit 1
          Exit Sub
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
  e = Swarm.Hit(px, PY * 16, 11 * 16)
  If e >= 0 Then
    If (Swarm.es(e) <> Swarm.S_FORM) And (Swarm.es(e) <> Swarm.S_HELD) Then
      Kill e, 0
      FighterHit 0
      Exit Sub
    End If
  End If
  If dual Then
    e = Swarm.Hit(px + 256, PY * 16, 11 * 16)
    If e >= 0 Then
      If (Swarm.es(e) <> Swarm.S_FORM) And (Swarm.es(e) <> Swarm.S_HELD) Then
        Kill e, 0
        FighterHit 1
      End If
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' a missile hit enemy e
Sub Shot(ByVal e As Integer)
  hits = hits + 1
  If (Swarm.ek(e) = Swarm.K_QUEEN) And (Swarm.eh(e) = 2) Then
    Swarm.eh(e) = 1
    Sid.Play 1, 80, 10, 13, 14
    Exit Sub
  End If
  Kill e, 1
End Sub

' enemy e gone (shot or crashed into the fighter)
Sub Kill(ByVal e As Integer, ByVal byShot As Integer)
  Dim s As Integer, pts As Integer, diving As Integer, q As Integer, c As Integer
  s = Swarm.es(e)
  diving = (s <> Swarm.S_FORM)
  Swarm.es(e) = Swarm.S_DYING
  Swarm.ef(e) = 0
  If e < 40 Then alive = alive - 1
  Sid.Play 3, 5, 0, 13, 18
  Select Case Swarm.ek(e)
    Case Swarm.K_DRONE
      pts = 50
      If diving Then pts = 100
    Case Swarm.K_HORNET
      pts = 80
      If diving Then pts = 160
      If s = Swarm.S_ESCORT Then
        q = Swarm.eo(e)
        escK(q) = escK(q) + 1
      End If
    Case Swarm.K_QUEEN
      pts = 150
      If diving Then
        pts = 400
        If escN(e) > 0 Then
          If escK(e) >= 2 Then
            pts = 1600
          ElseIf escK(e) = 1 Then
            pts = 800
          End If
        End If
        PopupAt e, pts
      End If
      If beamQ = e Then
        HideBeam
        beamQ = -1
        If pstate = 3 Then pstate = 0
      End If
      If cap(e) Then
        c = 40 + e
        cap(e) = 0
        If (s = Swarm.S_FORM) Or (pstate <> 0) Or dual Then
          ' in the formation: the fighter turns on you, and leaves
          Swarm.Dive c, Paths.P_ROGUE, 2
        Else
          ' diving: the fighter is free - it comes down beside yours
          Swarm.es(c) = Swarm.S_FREEFLY
          freeing = c
          pspin = 0
        End If
      End If
    Case Swarm.K_FIGHTER
      pts = 500
      If s = Swarm.S_HELD Then pts = 1000
      q = Swarm.eo(e)
      cap(q) = 0
      If freeing = e Then freeing = 0
  End Select
  If bonusStage Then
    pts = 100
    If byShot Then bonusHits = bonusHits + 1
  End If
  AddScore pts
End Sub

' the fighter (or the second one: side 1) is hit
Sub FighterHit(ByVal side As Integer)
  Sid.Play 3, 6, 0, 15, 60
  Sid.Play 1, 300, 6, 14, 60
  If dual Then
    ' one of the two: the other flies on
    dual = 0
    pexX = px \ 16
    If side = 1 Then
      pexX = pexX + 16
    Else
      px = px + 256
    End If
    Vic.Hide SP_P2
    pexT = 1
    Exit Sub
  End If
  pstate = 1
  pt = 0
  Vic.Hide SP_P1
End Sub

' ============================================================
' dives
' ============================================================
Sub Dives()
  Dim e As Integer, tries As Integer, c As Integer, flying As Integer, m As Integer, q As Integer
  If bonusStage Or (phase <> 1) Or (qi < qn) Or (pstate <> 0) Then Exit Sub
  diveT = diveT - 1
  If diveT > 0 Then Exit Sub
  diveT = 70 - stage * 4
  If diveT < 24 Then diveT = 24
  flying = OnScreen()
  If flying >= 2 + stage \ 2 Then Exit Sub
  ' pick one in the formation
  For tries = 1 To 8
    e = Rnd(40)
    If Swarm.es(e) = Swarm.S_FORM Then Exit For
  Next
  If Swarm.es(e) <> Swarm.S_FORM Then Exit Sub
  m = 0
  If ((e >= 4) And (e < 20) And (((e - 4) Mod 8) >= 4)) Or ((e >= 20) And (((e - 20) Mod 10) >= 5)) Or ((e < 4) And (e >= 2)) Then m = 1
  Select Case Swarm.ek(e)
    Case Swarm.K_DRONE
      Swarm.Dive e, Paths.P_DRONE, m
    Case Swarm.K_HORNET
      Swarm.Dive e, Paths.P_HORNET, m
    Case Swarm.K_QUEEN
      If (cap(e) = 0) And (dual = 0) And (beamQ < 0) And (freeing = 0) And (Rnd(100) < 45) Then
        ' down to beam the fighter up
        Swarm.Dive e, Paths.P_BEAM, m
        Swarm.tx(e) = px
        If Swarm.tx(e) < 40 * 16 Then Swarm.tx(e) = 40 * 16
        If Swarm.tx(e) > 216 * 16 Then Swarm.tx(e) = 216 * 16
        Swarm.ty(e) = 100 * 16
        beamQ = e
        beamT = -1
      Else
        ' with up to two Hornets beside her
        Swarm.Dive e, Paths.P_QUEEN, m
        escN(e) = 0
        escK(e) = 0
        For q = 4 To 11
          If (Swarm.es(q) = Swarm.S_FORM) And (escN(e) < 2) Then
            c = (q - 4) + 1
            If Abs(c - (e + 3)) <= 1 Then
              Swarm.es(q) = Swarm.S_ESCORT
              Swarm.eo(q) = e
              Swarm.tx(q) = 256 - 512 * escN(e)
              Swarm.ty(q) = Paths.P_ESCAPE
              escN(e) = escN(e) + 1
            End If
          End If
        Next
      End If
  End Select
  Sid.Play 2, 100, 3, 7, 40
End Sub

' ============================================================
' the tractor beam
' ============================================================
Sub Beam()
  Dim q As Integer, bxx As Integer, byy As Integer, pieces As Integer, j As Integer, v As Integer
  If beamQ < 0 Then Exit Sub
  q = beamQ
  If Swarm.es(q) <> Swarm.S_BEAM Then
    If beamT >= 0 Then HideBeam: beamQ = -1
    Exit Sub
  End If
  beamT = beamT + 1
  If pstate = 3 Then
    ' a fighter on its way up: the beam stays until it arrives
    If beamT > 150 Then beamT = 150
  End If
  pieces = 0
  If beamT < 150 Then
    pieces = beamT \ 14 + 1
  ElseIf beamT < 192 Then
    pieces = 3 - (beamT - 150) \ 14
  End If
  If pieces > 3 Then pieces = 3
  bxx = Swarm.ex(q) \ 16
  byy = Swarm.ey(q) \ 16 + 8
  For j = 0 To 2
    If j < pieces Then
      v = Gfx.I_BEAM + j
      Vic.Sprite SP_BEAM + j * 2, bxx - 24, byy + j * 32, v, Vic.Palette * 3
      Vic.Sprite SP_BEAM + j * 2 + 1, bxx, byy + j * 32, v, Vic.Palette * 3 + Vic.FlipX
    Else
      Vic.Hide SP_BEAM + j * 2
      Vic.Hide SP_BEAM + j * 2 + 1
    End If
  Next
  ' the beam's colours run down it, and it warbles
  If (beamT And 3) = 0 Then
    v = (beamT \ 4) And 3
    Vic.Color 73 + v, &HCEE
    Vic.Color 73 + ((v + 1) And 3), &H48C
    Vic.Color 73 + ((v + 2) And 3), &H26E
    Vic.Color 73 + ((v + 3) And 3), &H04A
    If pieces > 0 Then Sid.Play 2, 60 + (beamT And 4) * 8, 0, 9, 6
  End If
  ' caught?
  If (pstate = 0) And (pieces = 3) And (beamT < 150) And (dual = 0) Then
    If Abs(px - Swarm.ex(q)) < 20 * 16 Then
      pstate = 3
      pspin = 0
      pyy = PY
      Sid.Play 1, 120, 4, 12, 90
    End If
  End If
  If beamT = 192 Then
    HideBeam
    beamQ = -1
    Swarm.Dive q, Paths.P_UP, 0
    Swarm.ea(q) = 0
  End If
End Sub

Sub HideBeam()
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = 0 To 5
    Vic.Hide SP_BEAM + j
  Next
End Sub

' the fighter has reached the Queen: it is hers now
Sub Captured()
  Dim q As Integer
  q = beamQ
  cap(q) = 1
  Swarm.es(40 + q) = Swarm.S_HELD
  Swarm.ek(40 + q) = Swarm.K_FIGHTER
  Swarm.eo(40 + q) = q
  Vic.Hide SP_P1
  HideBeam
  beamQ = -1
  Swarm.Dive q, Paths.P_UP, 0
  Swarm.ea(q) = 0
  Pen 1
  Locate 9, 16: Print "FIGHTER CAPTURED"
  Pen 0
  pstate = 2
  pt = 0
  Sid.Play 2, 200, 8, 12, 60
End Sub

' a freed fighter coming down to dock beside the fighter
Sub FreeFighter()
  Dim c As Integer, tx As Integer, ty As Integer
  If freeing = 0 Then Exit Sub
  c = freeing
  If pstate <> 0 Then
    ' no fighter to join: it flies away
    Swarm.Dive c, Paths.P_ROGUE, 2
    freeing = 0
    Exit Sub
  End If
  pspin = pspin + 1
  tx = px + 256
  ty = PY * 16
  If Swarm.ex(c) < tx - 32 Then Swarm.ex(c) = Swarm.ex(c) + 32
  If Swarm.ex(c) > tx + 32 Then Swarm.ex(c) = Swarm.ex(c) - 32
  If Abs(Swarm.ex(c) - tx) <= 32 Then Swarm.ex(c) = tx
  If Swarm.ey(c) < ty Then Swarm.ey(c) = Swarm.ey(c) + 32
  If Swarm.ey(c) > ty Then Swarm.ey(c) = ty
  Swarm.ea(c) = (pspin * 32) And 1023
  If (Swarm.ex(c) = tx) And (Swarm.ey(c) = ty) Then
    Swarm.es(c) = 0
    freeing = 0
    dual = 1
    Sid.Play 2, 120, -3, 12, 40
  End If
End Sub

' ============================================================
' score, lives, the panel
' ============================================================
Sub AddScore(ByVal p As Integer)
  score = score + p
  If score >= nextLife Then
    lives = lives + 1
    If nextLife = 20000 Then
      nextLife = 70000
    Else
      nextLife = nextLife + 70000
    End If
    ShowLives
    Sid.Play 2, 200, -6, 12, 30
  End If
  If score > hi Then hi = score
  Pen 0
  ShowNum 33, 5, score
  If score = hi Then ShowNum 33, 2, hi
End Sub

' a Long right aligned in 7 columns from column x, row y
Sub ShowNum(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal v As Long)
  Dim s As String
  s = "       " & CStr(v)
  Locate x, y
  Print Right$(s, 7);
End Sub

Sub Hud()
  Pen 1
  Locate 35, 1: Print "HIGH"
  Locate 35, 4: Print "1UP"
  Pen 0
  ShowNum 33, 2, hi
  ShowNum 33, 5, score
  Pen 2
  Locate 34, 8: Print "STAGE"
  Pen 0
  ShowNum 33, 9, stage
  Flags
  ShowLives
End Sub

' the reserve fighters, bottom right
Sub ShowLives()
  Dim j As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer
  Vic.Box 256, 160, 64, 40, 0
  For j = 0 To 5
    x = 264 + (j Mod 3) * 16
    y = 162 + (j \ 3) * 18
    If j < lives Then Vic.Stamp Gfx.I_LIFE, x, y, Vic.Palette
  Next
End Sub

' the stage flags (a big one for 5)
Sub Flags()
  Dim s As Integer, c As Integer
  Vic.Box 256, 84, 64, 40, 0
  s = stage
  c = 0
  Do While (s >= 5) And (c < 7)
    Vic.Stamp Gfx.I_FLAG5, 264 + c * 8, 88, 0
    s = s - 5
    c = c + 1
  Loop
  Do While (s > 0) And (c < 7)
    Vic.Stamp Gfx.I_FLAG1, 264 + c * 8, 88, 0
    s = s - 1
    c = c + 1
  Loop
End Sub

' the bonus stage's result
Sub BonusScore()
  Dim b As Long
  If bonusHits >= 40 Then
    b = 10000
  Else
    b = bonusHits * 100
  End If
  Pen 3
  Locate 8, 11: Print "NUMBER OF HITS  "; bonusHits
  If bonusHits >= 40 Then
    Pen 1
    Locate 12, 13: Print "PERFECT !"
  End If
  Pen 2
  Locate 8, 15: Print "BONUS  "; b
  Pen 0
  score = score + b
  AddScore 0
  TuneStart 3
End Sub

' the score a Queen was worth, where she fell
Sub PopupAt(ByVal e As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
  Dim tl As Integer
  Select Case p
    Case 400: tl = 0
    Case 800: tl = 1
    Case 1600: tl = 2
    Case Else: Exit Sub
  End Select
  Vic.Sprite SP_POP, Swarm.ex(e) \ 16 - 12, Swarm.ey(e) \ 16 - 4, Gfx.I_POP + tl, Vic.Palette * 2
  popT = 60
End Sub

Sub Popup()
  If popT > 0 Then
    popT = popT - 1
    If popT = 0 Then Vic.Hide SP_POP
  End If
End Sub

' the game's end: shots, hits, the ratio
Sub Results()
  Dim r As Long
  Cls
  Pen 1
  Locate 11, 7: Print "- RESULTS -"
  Pen 2
  Locate 4, 11: Print "SHOTS FIRED"
  Locate 4, 14: Print "NUMBER OF HITS"
  Locate 4, 17: Print "HIT-MISS RATIO"
  Pen 0
  ShowNum 21, 11, shots
  ShowNum 21, 14, hits
  r = 0
  If shots > 0 Then r = (hits * 1000) \ shots
  Locate 23, 17: Print r \ 10; "."; r Mod 10; " %"
  For i = 1 To 300
    Vic.Update
    Stars
  Next
End Sub

' ============================================================
' the stars: 64, moving down, twinkling (colours 25-30 cycled)
' ============================================================
Sub MakeStars()
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = 0 To 63
    Vic.Star j, Rnd(256), Rnd(256), 25 + Rnd(6)
  Next
  Vic.Stars 64
End Sub

Sub Stars()
  If pstate <> 1 Then
    starY = starY + 1
    Vic.StarScroll starY
  End If
  starT = starT + 1
  If (starT And 7) = 0 Then
    k = (starT \ 8) Mod 6
    Vic.Color 25 + k, 0
    Vic.Color 25 + ((k + 3) Mod 6), starCol(k)
  End If
End Sub

' ============================================================
' tunes (channel 2): period, frames ... 0
' ============================================================
Sub TuneStart(ByVal which As Integer)
  Dim s As String
  Select Case which
    Case 1
      s = "214,8,170,8,143,8,107,16,143,8,107,24,0,8,127,8,143,8,160,8,170,16,214,24"
    Case 2
      s = "143,6,127,6,113,6,107,6,113,6,127,6,143,12,107,12,95,12,85,24"
    Case 3
      s = "107,6,0,2,107,6,0,2,107,6,95,6,85,6,80,24"
  End Select
  tuneN = 0
  k = 1
  Do While k <= Len(s)
    tune(tuneN) = Val(Mid$(s, k))
    tuneN = tuneN + 1
    Do While (k <= Len(s)) And (Mid$(s, k, 1) <> ",")
      k = k + 1
    Loop
    k = k + 1
  Loop
  tuneI = 0
  tuneW = 0
End Sub

Sub TuneUpdate()
  If tuneI >= tuneN Then Exit Sub
  If tuneW > 0 Then
    tuneW = tuneW - 1
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If tune(tuneI) > 0 Then Sid.Play 2, tune(tuneI), 0, 11, tune(tuneI + 1)
  tuneW = tune(tuneI + 1) - 1
  tuneI = tuneI + 2
End Sub

files.text:
' Swarm - CYBORG SWARM's enemies: where each is, where it is going, and its sprite.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
'
' 44 enemies: 0-3 the Queens, 4-19 the Hornets, 20-39 the Drones (each has its slot in the
' formation), 40-43 a fighter a Queen has captured (40 + the Queen's number).
' Positions are in 1/16 pixels on the playfield (256 x 200, its top left at the screen's);
' angles 1024 a turn, 0 = up, 256 = right (Paths.cls).
' Swarm.Step moves them all a frame on and puts their sprites in Vic's sprite table;
' Swarm.Hit finds one at a point. Both are 45GS02 code (keywords); the game decides the rest.

Public Const NE = 44            ' enemies
Public Const SPR0 = 20          ' their sprites: 20-63

' states (es)
Public Const S_FREE = 0
Public Const S_PATH = 1         ' following a path (ep: where in Paths.Table, en: frames left)
Public Const S_HOME = 2         ' flying to its slot
Public Const S_FORM = 3         ' in the formation
Public Const S_BEAM = 5         ' a Queen holding still (its tractor beam: the game's)
Public Const S_DYING = 6        ' exploding (ef counts 0-15)
Public Const S_HELD = 9         ' a captured fighter behind its Queen (eo)
Public Const S_FREEFLY = 11     ' moved by the game (a fighter being freed)
Public Const S_GOTO = 13        ' flying to tx, ty, then S_BEAM
Public Const S_ESCORT = 14      ' beside its Queen (eo) at tx (+/- 256), on its own: path ty

' kinds (ek)
Public Const K_DRONE = 0
Public Const K_HORNET = 1
Public Const K_QUEEN = 2
Public Const K_FIGHTER = 3

Public es(43) As Integer, ek(43) As Integer, ex(43) As Integer, ey(43) As Integer
Public ea(43) As Integer, ev(43) As Integer, et(43) As Integer, ep(43) As Integer
Public en(43) As Integer, eh(43) As Integer, ef(43) As Integer, eo(43) As Integer
Public em(43) As Integer, tx(43) As Integer, ty(43) As Integer

' the formation: its middle (x), its top row (y), half a column's width, a row's height
Public fcx As Integer, fcy As Integer, sprx As Integer, spry As Integer
Public anim As Integer          ' frames (the wings beat on it)
Public ptx As Integer, pty As Integer   ' where an aiming enemy turns to (the fighter)
Public fq(7) As Integer, fqn As Integer ' enemies that have just aimed (the game may shoot)
Public pathbase As Integer, sinbase As Integer, atanbase As Integer, slotbase As Integer

' the tables' addresses (once, at the start)
Public Sub Init()
  pathbase = Paths.Table()
  sinbase = Paths.Sines()
  atanbase = Paths.Atans()
  slotbase = Paths.Slots()
  fcx = 128 * 16
  fcy = 36 * 16
  sprx = 128
  spry = 256
End Sub

' every enemy a frame on, and its sprite
' (base page: z_t0 = the enemy * 2, z_a .. z_g working values; the real stack: jsr)
Public Sub Step()
#asm
            NTC_RS
            inc {anim}
            bne an1
            inc {anim}+1
an1:
            lda #0
            sta z_t0
loop:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {es},x
            beq jdraw
            cmp #1
            beq jpath
            cmp #2
            beq jhome
            cmp #3
            beq jform
            cmp #6
            beq jdying
            cmp #9
            beq jheld
            cmp #13
            beq jgoto
            cmp #14
            beq jescort
jdraw:
            jmp draw
jpath:
            jmp st_path
jhome:
            jmp st_home
jform:
            jmp st_form
jdying:
            jmp st_dying
jheld:
            jmp st_held
jgoto:
            jmp st_goto
jescort:
            jmp st_escort

; ---- following a path
st_path:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {en},x
            ora {en}+1,x
            bne p_move
p_seg:
            ldx z_t0                    ; the segment: frames, turn, speed
            lda {ep},x
            asl
            sta z_p0
            lda {ep}+1,x
            rol
            sta z_p0+1
            clc
            lda z_p0
            adc {pathbase}
            sta z_p0
            lda z_p0+1
            adc {pathbase}+1
            sta z_p0+1
            ldy #0
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_d                     ; frames
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_d+1
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_e                     ; turn (the end: the next state)
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_e+1
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_f                     ; speed
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_f+1
            clc                         ; ep += 3
            lda {ep},x
            adc #3
            sta {ep},x
            lda {ep}+1,x
            adc #0
            sta {ep}+1,x
            lda z_d+1
            bmi p_aim
            ora z_d
            bne p_new
            jmp p_end
p_aim:
            ; aim: face the fighter, and say so (the game may shoot)
            sec
            lda {ptx}
            sbc {ex},x
            sta z_a
            lda {ptx}+1
            sbc {ex}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            sec
            lda {pty}
            sbc {ey},x
            sta z_b
            lda {pty}+1
            sbc {ey}+1,x
            sta z_b+1
            jsr atan
            ldx z_t0
            lda z_a
            sta {ea},x
            lda z_a+1
            sta {ea}+1,x
            lda {fqn}
            cmp #8
            bcs p_seg
            asl
            tay
            lda z_t0
            lsr
            sta {fq},y
            lda #0
            sta {fq}+1,y
            inc {fqn}
            jmp p_seg
p_new:
            lda z_d
            sta {en},x
            lda z_d+1
            sta {en}+1,x
            lda {em},x                  ; mirrored: the other way
            and #1
            beq p_nm
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_e
            sta z_e
            lda #0
            sbc z_e+1
            sta z_e+1
p_nm:
            lda z_e
            sta {et},x
            lda z_e+1
            sta {et}+1,x
            lda z_f
            sta {ev},x
            lda z_f+1
            sta {ev}+1,x
p_move:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {en},x                  ; en - 1
            bne p_m1
            dec {en}+1,x
p_m1:
            dec {en},x
            clc                         ; ea = (ea + et) and 1023
            lda {ea},x
            adc {et},x
            sta {ea},x
            sta z_a
            lda {ea}+1,x
            adc {et}+1,x
            and #3
            sta {ea}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            lda {ev},x
            sta z_c
            lda {ev}+1,x
            sta z_c+1
            jsr fwd
            ldx z_t0                    ; off the playfield?
            lda {ey},x                  ; y > 212 * 16 or y < -48 * 16
            sta z_a
            lda {ey}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            lda #<(212*16)
            sta z_b
            lda #>(212*16)
            sta z_b+1
            jsr sgt                     ; z_a > z_b: carry set
            bcs p_off
            lda #<(-48*16)
            sta z_b
            lda #>(-48*16)
            sta z_b+1
            jsr slt
            bcs p_off
            ldx z_t0
            lda {ex},x                  ; x < -40 * 16 or x > 296 * 16
            sta z_a
            lda {ex}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            lda #<(-40*16)
            sta z_b
            lda #>(-40*16)
            sta z_b+1
            jsr slt
            bcs p_off
            lda #<(296*16)
            sta z_b
            lda #>(296*16)
            sta z_b+1
            jsr sgt
            bcs p_off
            jmp draw
p_off:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {em},x                  ; leaving for good (the bonus stage, a rogue)
            and #2
            bne off_gone
            lda #7                      ; else round to the top
            sta z_e
            lda #0
            sta z_e+1
p_end:                                  ; z_e = the state after the path
            ldx z_t0
            lda z_e
            cmp #7
            bne p_e2
            lda #<(-16*16)              ; round: from the top, over its slot, home
            sta {ey},x
            lda #>(-16*16)
            sta {ey}+1,x
            jsr slot
            ldx z_t0
            lda z_a
            sta {ex},x
            lda z_a+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            lda #<512
            sta {ea},x
            lda #>512
            sta {ea}+1,x
            lda #2
            sta z_e
p_e2:
            lda z_e
            cmp #12
            beq off_gone
            sta {es},x
            lda #0
            sta {es}+1,x
            lda #40                     ; flying home at 2.5 pixels a frame
            sta {ev},x
            lda #0
            sta {ev}+1,x
            jmp draw
off_gone:
            ldx z_t0
            lda #0
            sta {es},x
            sta {es}+1,x
            jmp draw

; ---- to the slot / to tx, ty
st_home:
            jsr slot
            jmp seek
st_goto:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {tx},x
            sta z_a
            lda {tx}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            lda {ty},x
            sta z_b
            lda {ty}+1,x
            sta z_b+1
seek:                                   ; z_a, z_b = the target
            lda z_a
            sta z_d
            lda z_a+1
            sta z_d+1
            lda z_b
            sta z_e
            lda z_b+1
            sta z_e+1
            ldx z_t0
            sec                         ; dx, dy
            lda z_a
            sbc {ex},x
            sta z_a
            lda z_a+1
            sbc {ex}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            sec
            lda z_b
            sbc {ey},x
            sta z_b
            lda z_b+1
            sbc {ey}+1,x
            sta z_b+1
            lda z_a                     ; |dx|, |dy|
            sta z_f
            lda z_a+1
            sta z_f+1
            bpl sk1
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_f
            sta z_f
            lda #0
            sbc z_f+1
            sta z_f+1
sk1:
            lda z_b
            sta z_g
            lda z_b+1
            sta z_g+1
            bpl sk2
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_g
            sta z_g
            lda #0
            sbc z_g+1
            sta z_g+1
sk2:
            lda z_f+1                   ; both under 40: there
            bne sk_far
            lda z_f
            cmp #40
            bcs sk_far
            lda z_g+1
            bne sk_far
            lda z_g
            cmp #40
            bcs sk_far
            ldx z_t0
            lda z_d
            sta {ex},x
            lda z_d+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            lda z_e
            sta {ey},x
            lda z_e+1
            sta {ey}+1,x
            lda #<512
            sta {ea},x
            lda #>512
            sta {ea}+1,x
            lda {es},x
            cmp #2
            beq sk_form
            lda #5
            bne sk_set
sk_form:
            lda #3
sk_set:
            sta {es},x
            lda #0
            sta {es}+1,x
            jmp draw
sk_far:
            lda z_f+1                   ; both under 20 pixels: straight there
            cmp #>(20*16)
            bcc sk_n1
            bne sk_steer
            lda z_f
            cmp #<(20*16)
            bcs sk_steer
sk_n1:
            lda z_g+1
            cmp #>(20*16)
            bcc sk_near
            bne sk_steer
            lda z_g
            cmp #<(20*16)
            bcs sk_steer
sk_near:
            lda #48                     ; near: straight there, turning to face down
            sta z_c
            jsr clampadd
            ldx z_t0
            sec
            lda #<512
            sbc {ea},x
            sta z_a
            lda #>512
            sbc {ea}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            jsr turnby
            jmp draw
sk_steer:
            jsr atan                    ; the way there
            ldx z_t0
            sec
            lda z_a
            sbc {ea},x
            sta z_a
            lda z_a+1
            sbc {ea}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            jsr turnby
            ldx z_t0
            lda {ea},x
            sta z_a
            lda {ea}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            lda {ev},x
            sta z_c
            lda {ev}+1,x
            sta z_c+1
            jsr fwd
            jmp draw

; ---- in the formation
st_form:
            jsr slot
            ldx z_t0
            lda z_a
            sta {ex},x
            lda z_a+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            lda z_b
            sta {ey},x
            lda z_b+1
            sta {ey}+1,x
            lda #<512
            sta {ea},x
            lda #>512
            sta {ea}+1,x
            jmp draw

; ---- exploding
st_dying:
            ldx z_t0
            inc {ef},x
            lda {ef},x
            cmp #16
            bcc jd2
            lda #0
            sta {es},x
            sta {es}+1,x
jd2:
            jmp draw

; ---- a captured fighter: 16 pixels behind its Queen
st_held:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {eo},x
            asl
            tay                         ; Y = the Queen * 2
            lda {ea},y
            sta {ea},x
            sta z_a
            lda {ea}+1,y
            sta {ea}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            sty z_t1
            jsr getsin                  ; x = the Queen's - sin
            ldx z_t0
            ldy z_t1
            sec
            lda {ex},y
            sbc z_b
            sta {ex},x
            lda {ex}+1,y
            sbc z_b+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            clc                         ; y = the Queen's + cos
            lda z_a
            adc #<256
            sta z_a
            lda z_a+1
            adc #>256
            sta z_a+1
            jsr getsin
            ldx z_t0
            ldy z_t1
            clc
            lda {ey},y
            adc z_b
            sta {ey},x
            lda {ey}+1,y
            adc z_b+1
            sta {ey}+1,x
            jmp draw

; ---- an escort: beside its Queen while she dives, else on its own
st_escort:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {eo},x
            asl
            tay
            sty z_t1
            lda {es},y
            cmp #1
            beq es_ok
            lda #1                      ; its own path from here
            sta {es},x
            lda #0
            sta {es}+1,x
            lda {ty},x
            sta {ep},x
            lda {ty}+1,x
            sta {ep}+1,x
            lda #0
            sta {en},x
            sta {en}+1,x
            jmp draw
es_ok:
            lda {ea},y
            sta {ea},x
            sta z_a
            lda {ea}+1,y
            sta {ea}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            clc                         ; cos: the Queen's right is (cos, sin)
            lda z_a
            adc #<256
            sta z_a
            lda z_a+1
            adc #>256
            sta z_a+1
            jsr getsin
            ldx z_t0
            lda {tx},x
            sta z_c
            lda {tx}+1,x
            sta z_c+1
            jsr mul8
            ldx z_t0
            ldy z_t1
            clc
            lda {ex},y
            adc z_b
            sta {ex},x
            lda {ex}+1,y
            adc z_b+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            sec                         ; sin
            lda z_a
            sbc #<256
            sta z_a
            lda z_a+1
            sbc #>256
            sta z_a+1
            jsr getsin
            ldx z_t0
            lda {tx},x
            sta z_c
            lda {tx}+1,x
            sta z_c+1
            jsr mul8
            ldx z_t0
            ldy z_t1
            clc
            lda {ey},y
            adc z_b
            sta {ey},x
            lda {ey}+1,y
            adc z_b+1
            sta {ey}+1,x
            jmp draw

; ---- the sprite: Vic's sprite table entry SPR0 + the enemy (8 bytes: x, y, image,
; attributes, shown)
draw:
            lda #0                      ; the entry: ntc_vic_sat + (SPR0 + i) * 8 (z_t0 = i * 2)
            sta z_p1+1
            lda z_t0
            asl
            rol z_p1+1
            asl
            rol z_p1+1
            clc
            adc #<(ntc_vic_sat+{spr0}*8)
            sta z_p1
            lda z_p1+1
            adc #>(ntc_vic_sat+{spr0}*8)
            sta z_p1+1
            ldx z_t0
            lda {es},x
            bne dr_on
            jmp dr_hide
dr_on:
            lda {ey},x                  ; y = ey / 16 - 8
            sta z_b
            lda {ey}+1,x
            sta z_b+1
            ldy #4
dr_ys:
            lda z_b+1
            cmp #$80
            ror z_b+1
            ror z_b
            dey
            bne dr_ys
            sec
            lda z_b
            sbc #8
            sta z_b
            lda z_b+1
            sbc #0
            sta z_b+1
            bpl dr_yok                  ; above -32: hidden
            cmp #$FF
            bne dr_hide
            lda z_b
            cmp #$E0
            bcc dr_hide
dr_yok:
            lda {ex},x                  ; x = ex / 16 - 8
            sta z_c
            lda {ex}+1,x
            sta z_c+1
            ldy #4
dr_xs:
            lda z_c+1
            cmp #$80
            ror z_c+1
            ror z_c
            dey
            bne dr_xs
            sec
            lda z_c
            sbc #8
            sta z_c
            lda z_c+1
            sbc #0
            sta z_c+1
            ldy #0                      ; x, y into the entry
            lda z_c
            sta (z_p1),y
            iny
            lda z_c+1
            sta (z_p1),y
            iny
            lda z_b
            sta (z_p1),y
            iny
            lda z_b+1
            sta (z_p1),y
            lda {es},x
            cmp #6
            bne dr_dir
            lda {ef},x                  ; exploding: frame ef / 4, palette 2
            lsr
            lsr
            clc
            adc #{gfx.i_expl}
            sta z_d
            lda #32
            sta z_d+1
            jmp dr_put
dr_dir:
            clc                         ; 16 directions -> 5 drawn, flipped
            lda {ea},x
            adc #32
            sta z_a
            lda {ea}+1,x
            adc #0
            sta z_a+1
            ldy #6
dr_ds:
            lsr z_a+1
            ror z_a
            dey
            bne dr_ds
            lda z_a
            and #15
            ldy #0                      ; Y = the flips
            cmp #5
            bcc dr_f
            cmp #9
            bcs dr_d2
            eor #$FF                    ; 8 - d
            sec
            adc #8
            ldy #2                      ; flip y
            bne dr_f
dr_d2:
            cmp #13
            bcs dr_d3
            sec
            sbc #8
            ldy #3                      ; flip x and y
            bne dr_f
dr_d3:
            eor #$FF                    ; 16 - d
            sec
            adc #16
            ldy #1                      ; flip x
dr_f:
            sta z_e                     ; the frame (0-4)
            sty z_e+1
            lda {ek},x
            cmp #3
            beq dr_fighter
            tay                         ; the kind's first image + frame * 2 + the wings
            lda z_e
            asl
            sta z_e
            lda {anim}
            lsr
            lsr
            lsr
            lsr
            and #1
            ora z_e
            clc
            adc dr_bases,y
            sta z_d
            lda #32                     ; Drones, Hornets: palette 2
            cpy #2
            bne dr_pal
            lda #16                     ; a Queen: palette 1, hit: palette 3
            ldy {eh},x
            cpy #2
            beq dr_pal
            lda #48
            jmp dr_pal
dr_fighter:
            lda z_e
            clc
            adc #{gfx.i_fighter}
            sta z_d
            lda #48                     ; a captured fighter: palette 3 (red)
            ldy {es},x
            cpy #11
            bne dr_pal
            lda #16                     ; being freed: yours again (palette 1)
dr_pal:
            ora z_e+1
            sta z_d+1
dr_put:
            ldy #4
            lda z_d
            sta (z_p1),y
            iny
            lda z_d+1
            sta (z_p1),y
            iny
            lda #1
            sta (z_p1),y
            jmp next
dr_hide:
            ldy #6
            lda #0
            sta (z_p1),y
next:
            inc z_t0
            inc z_t0
            lda z_t0
            cmp #88
            bcs fin
            jmp loop
fin:
            NTC_TS
            jmp done

dr_bases:
            db {gfx.i_drone}, {gfx.i_hornet}, {gfx.i_queen}

; ---- z_b = sin(z_a) (* 256): z_a any angle
getsin:
            lda z_a
            asl
            sta z_p0
            lda z_a+1
            and #3
            rol
            sta z_p0+1
            clc
            lda z_p0
            adc {sinbase}
            sta z_p0
            lda z_p0+1
            adc {sinbase}+1
            sta z_p0+1
            ldy #0
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_b
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_b+1
            rts

; ---- z_b = z_b * z_c / 256 (signed: the hardware multiplier, the product's bytes 1-2)
mul8:
            lda z_b
            sta $D770
            lda z_b+1
            sta $D771
            and #$80
            beq m8a
            lda #$FF
m8a:
            sta $D772
            sta $D773
            lda z_c
            sta $D774
            lda z_c+1
            sta $D775
            and #$80
            beq m8b
            lda #$FF
m8b:
            sta $D776
            sta $D777
            lda $D779
            sta z_b
            lda $D77A
            sta z_b+1
            rts

; ---- x, y += the angle z_a at speed z_c (enemy z_t0)
fwd:
            jsr getsin
            jsr mul8
            ldx z_t0
            clc
            lda {ex},x
            adc z_b
            sta {ex},x
            lda {ex}+1,x
            adc z_b+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            clc
            lda z_a
            adc #<256
            sta z_a
            lda z_a+1
            adc #>256
            sta z_a+1
            jsr getsin
            jsr mul8
            ldx z_t0
            sec
            lda {ey},x
            sbc z_b
            sta {ey},x
            lda {ey}+1,x
            sbc z_b+1
            sta {ey}+1,x
            rts

; ---- z_a, z_b = the slot's x, y (a captured fighter: where it is)
slot:
            lda z_t0
            cmp #80
            bcs slot_self
            asl                         ; the slot's column, row (2 words each)
            clc
            adc {slotbase}
            sta z_p0
            lda {slotbase}+1
            adc #0
            sta z_p0+1
            ldy #0
            lda (z_p0),y                ; x = (column * 2 - 9) * sprx + fcx
            asl
            sec
            sbc #9
            sta z_b
            lda #0
            sbc #0
            sta z_b+1
            lda {sprx}
            sta z_c
            lda {sprx}+1
            sta z_c+1
            jsr mul16
            clc
            lda z_b
            adc {fcx}
            sta z_a
            lda z_b+1
            adc {fcx}+1
            sta z_a+1
            ldy #2
            lda (z_p0),y                ; y = row * spry + fcy
            sta z_b
            lda #0
            sta z_b+1
            lda {spry}
            sta z_c
            lda {spry}+1
            sta z_c+1
            jsr mul16
            clc
            lda z_b
            adc {fcy}
            sta z_b
            lda z_b+1
            adc {fcy}+1
            sta z_b+1
            rts
slot_self:
            ldx z_t0
            lda {ex},x
            sta z_a
            lda {ex}+1,x
            sta z_a+1
            lda {ey},x
            sta z_b
            lda {ey}+1,x
            sta z_b+1
            rts

; ---- z_b = z_b * z_c (the low 16 bits)
mul16:
            lda z_b
            sta $D770
            lda z_b+1
            sta $D771
            lda #0
            sta $D772
            sta $D773
            sta $D776
            sta $D777
            lda z_c
            sta $D774
            lda z_c+1
            sta $D775
            lda $D778
            sta z_b
            lda $D779
            sta z_b+1
            rts

; ---- ex += z_a, ey += z_b, each kept within +/- z_c (z_c: 0-127)
clampadd:
            lda z_a+1                   ; dx > c: c
            bmi ca1
            bne ca0
            lda z_a
            cmp z_c
            bcc ca2
            beq ca2
ca0:
            lda z_c
            sta z_a
            lda #0
            sta z_a+1
            jmp ca2
ca1:                                    ; dx < -c: -c
            cmp #$FF
            bne ca1b
            lda z_a
            clc
            adc z_c
            bcs ca2
ca1b:
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_c
            sta z_a
            lda #$FF
            sta z_a+1
ca2:
            lda z_b+1
            bmi ca3
            bne ca2b
            lda z_b
            cmp z_c
            bcc ca4
            beq ca4
ca2b:
            lda z_c
            sta z_b
            lda #0
            sta z_b+1
            jmp ca4
ca3:
            cmp #$FF
            bne ca3b
            lda z_b
            clc
            adc z_c
            bcs ca4
ca3b:
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_c
            sta z_b
            lda #$FF
            sta z_b+1
ca4:
            ldx z_t0
            clc
            lda {ex},x
            adc z_a
            sta {ex},x
            lda {ex}+1,x
            adc z_a+1
            sta {ex}+1,x
            clc
            lda {ey},x
            adc z_b
            sta {ey},x
            lda {ey}+1,x
            adc z_b+1
            sta {ey}+1,x
            rts

; ---- ea turned by z_a (the difference, any size: the short way, 28 at most)
turnby:
            lda z_a+1
            and #3
            sta z_a+1
            cmp #2                      ; >= 512: - 1024
            bcc tb1
            ora #$FC
            sta z_a+1
tb1:
            lda z_a+1                   ; > 28: 28
            bmi tb2
            bne tb1b
            lda z_a
            cmp #29
            bcc tb3
tb1b:
            lda #28
            sta z_a
            lda #0
            sta z_a+1
            jmp tb3
tb2:                                    ; < -28: -28
            cmp #$FF
            bne tb2b
            lda z_a
            cmp #<(-28)
            bcs tb3
tb2b:
            lda #<(-28)
            sta z_a
            lda #$FF
            sta z_a+1
tb3:
            ldx z_t0
            clc
            lda {ea},x
            adc z_a
            sta {ea},x
            lda {ea}+1,x
            adc z_a+1
            and #3
            sta {ea}+1,x
            rts

; ---- z_a = the angle of the way z_a = dx, z_b = dy (0 = up)
atan:
            lda #0
            sta z_t2                    ; bit 0 left, bit 1 down
            lda z_a+1
            bpl at1
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_a
            sta z_a
            lda #0
            sbc z_a+1
            sta z_a+1
            lda #1
            sta z_t2
at1:
            lda z_b+1
            bmi at2
            lda z_t2
            ora #2
            sta z_t2
            jmp at3
at2:
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_b
            sta z_b
            lda #0
            sbc z_b+1
            sta z_b+1
at3:
            lda z_b                     ; |dx| > |dy|: from the across line
            cmp z_a
            lda z_b+1
            sbc z_a+1
            bcc at_x
            lda z_b
            ora z_b+1
            beq at_zero
            ; t = |dx| * 32 / |dy| (0-32)
            lda z_a
            sta z_c
            lda z_a+1
            sta z_c+1
            lda z_b
            sta z_d
            lda z_b+1
            sta z_d+1
            jsr div32
            jsr atantab
            jmp at_q
at_x:
            lda z_b
            sta z_c
            lda z_b+1
            sta z_c+1
            lda z_a
            sta z_d
            lda z_a+1
            sta z_d+1
            jsr div32
            jsr atantab
            sec                         ; 256 - a
            lda #<256
            sbc z_a
            sta z_a
            lda #>256
            sbc z_a+1
            sta z_a+1
            jmp at_q
at_zero:
            lda #0
            sta z_a
            sta z_a+1
at_q:
            lda z_t2
            and #2
            bne at_down
            lda z_t2
            and #1
            beq at_e
            sec                         ; up, left: 1024 - a
            lda #<1024
            sbc z_a
            sta z_a
            lda #>1024
            sbc z_a+1
            and #3
            sta z_a+1
            jmp at_e
at_down:
            sec                         ; down, right: 512 - a
            lda #<512
            sbc z_a
            sta z_a
            lda #>512
            sbc z_a+1
            sta z_a+1
            lda z_t2
            and #1
            beq at_e
            sec                         ; down, left: 512 + a = 1024 - (512 - a)
            lda #<1024
            sbc z_a
            sta z_a
            lda #>1024
            sbc z_a+1
            sta z_a+1
at_e:
            rts
; z_a = atan table [A] (A = 0-32)
atantab:
            asl
            tay
            lda {atanbase}
            sta z_p0
            lda {atanbase}+1
            sta z_p0+1
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_a
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_a+1
            rts
; A = z_c * 32 / z_d (z_c <= z_d, unsigned): 0-32
div32:
            lda #0
            sta z_t3                    ; the quotient
            ldx #6                      ; 6 bits (the first: z_c >= z_d)
            jmp dv_cmp
dv_lp:
            asl z_c
            rol z_c+1
            asl z_t3
dv_cmp:
            lda z_c
            cmp z_d
            lda z_c+1
            sbc z_d+1
            bcc dv_n
            sta z_c+1
            lda z_c
            sbc z_d
            sta z_c
            inc z_t3
dv_n:
            dex
            bne dv_lp
            lda z_t3
            rts

; ---- signed compares: z_a > z_b / z_a < z_b, the answer in the carry
sgt:
            lda z_b                     ; z_b < z_a
            cmp z_a
            lda z_b+1
            sbc z_a+1
            bvc sg1
            eor #$80
sg1:
            asl                         ; the sign into the carry
            rts
slt:
            lda z_a
            cmp z_b
            lda z_a+1
            sbc z_b+1
            bvc sl1
            eor #$80
sl1:
            asl
            rts
done:
#endasm
End Sub

' the first enemy (not exploding, not gone, not a fighter being freed) within r of x, y (all in 1/16 pixels), or -1
Public Function Hit(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            NTC_POP z_p0
            ldy #0
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_a
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_a+1
            NTC_POP z_p0
            dey
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_b
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_b+1
            NTC_POP z_p0
            dey
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_c
            iny
            lda (z_p0),y
            sta z_c+1
            NTC_POP z_p2
            ldx #0
lp:
            lda {es},x
            beq nx
            cmp #6
            beq nx
            cmp #11                     ; a fighter being freed: yours, not a target
            beq nx
            sec                         ; |ex - x| < r
            lda {ex},x
            sbc z_a
            sta z_d
            lda {ex}+1,x
            sbc z_a+1
            bpl h1
            sta z_d+1
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_d
            sta z_d
            lda #0
            sbc z_d+1
h1:
            sta z_d+1
            lda z_d
            cmp z_c
            lda z_d+1
            sbc z_c+1
            bcs nx
            sec                         ; |ey - y| < r
            lda {ey},x
            sbc z_b
            sta z_d
            lda {ey}+1,x
            sbc z_b+1
            bpl h2
            sta z_d+1
            sec
            lda #0
            sbc z_d
            sta z_d
            lda #0
            sbc z_d+1
h2:
            sta z_d+1
            lda z_d
            cmp z_c
            lda z_d+1
            sbc z_c+1
            bcs nx
            txa                         ; found: its number
            lsr
            ldy #0
            sta (z_p2),y
            iny
            lda #0
            sta (z_p2),y
            jmp done
nx:
            inx
            inx
            cpx #88
            bcc lp
            ldy #0
            lda #$FF
            sta (z_p2),y
            iny
            sta (z_p2),y
done:
#endasm
End Function

' an enemy on its way along a path: from x, y facing angle a (pixels), mirrored or not
Public Sub Launch(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal path As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal mirror As Integer)
  es(i) = S_PATH
  ep(i) = path
  en(i) = 0
  em(i) = mirror
  ex(i) = x * 16
  ey(i) = y * 16
  ea(i) = a
End Sub

' a dive from where it is (in the formation)
Public Sub Dive(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal path As Integer, ByVal mirror As Integer)
  es(i) = S_PATH
  ep(i) = path
  en(i) = 0
  em(i) = mirror
End Sub
